name: fix-v3-add-fields
change: Add explicit confidence, originSessionId, and t_valid fields to hook-emitted memories.
rationale: Tests whether the hook layer can provide first-class storage fields without regressing fix-v2's content sanitization wins.
notes: This is cumulative over fix-v2-sanitize-content, so Stop session summaries remain disabled and build/test output remains sanitized.
t_valid is set to the queue record timestamp for all emitted hook records. t_invalid remains unset because these events have no known expiry.
originSessionId is copied from hook stdin session_id/sessionId or CLAUDE_SESSION_ID when available.
